## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] No determinism test was weakened or skipped
- [ ] New foundational choices have an ADR; contract changes have an RFC
- [ ] New data or assets carry provenance and licence, and are credited in ATTRIBUTION.md
- [ ] `docs/progress.md` is updated if this completes a milestone
